title: Fix approval browser editor lookup and verify exact sent text
public_pr_body:
The Approve and send browser test assumed the message editor lived inside the card and was labelled Message. Locate the active page-level editor so the real portalled Edit Email dialog's Body field works, while retaining compatibility with #161's inline chase editor. Save through the active editor and handle the approval confirmation when shown.

Assert the full reviewed subject and body match the persisted draft, confirmation fields, provider payload and sent history exactly. Keep the existing single-send, approver, queue-removal and reload checks.

Based on #161's branch as requested, with this draft PR targeting main. The inherited docs additions are excluded so the PR has no docs diff against main. No application source, migrations or SQL were changed by this fix; inherited #161 application changes remain in the stack.

Validation: typecheck and targeted ESLint passed; 29 approval and chase-wiring unit tests passed; all four chase-steps browser tests collect. The live browser suite and production build were not run: no disposable Supabase backend is configured, and no migrations or SQL were applied.
